about_the_game:
Welcome to Dawn of Decay, a thrilling 3D low poly multiplayer zombie survival game that plunges players into a world teetering on the brink of annihilation. As one of the few remaining survivors. fend off relentless hordes of zombies, and rely on your skills and teamwork to endure the onslaught.

Set in a variety of immersive maps. Dawn of Decay challenges players to work together to survive wave after wave of the undead. Every decision could mean the difference between life and death.

Key Features:

Dynamic weather: Fight hordes of zombies while enduring tough weather environments that can spawn different types of zombies!
Intense Multiplayer Action: Team up with friends in cooperative gameplay to tackle the zombie apocalypse together.
Dynamic Maps: Explore intricately designed maps, each with unique challenges and secrets to discover.
Survival Mechanics: Face relentless waves of zombies, forcing you to strategize and adapt to survive.
Low Poly Aesthetic: Enjoy a visually striking game with a distinct low poly art style that enhances the eerie atmosphere.
"Dawn of Decay" offers a unique blend of fast-paced action, strategic gameplay, and a visually captivating experience that will keep you and your friends on the edge of your seats. Are you ready to face the dawn and fight for survival?

Interested in insider development updates? or maybe you're just looking for someone to talk to? Join our discord!

  • Processor: Intel Core i3-10105F or equivalent
  • Memory: 8 GB RAM
  • Graphics: NVIDIA GeForce GTX 1650 or equivalent
  • Network: Broadband Internet connection
  • Storage: 8 GB available space
  • Sound Card: Recommended
  • VR Support: No

  • Processor: AMD Ryzen 9 5900x or equivalent
